verdict.rationale: Vercel is a proprietary managed cloud platform with no evidence of a self-hostable open-source core; evidence only covers hosted features (deployments, CLI, docs, agent tools) and community commentary about switching to actually self-hostable alternatives like Dokploy. Missing for 10: any open-source release of Vercel's core platform, self-host installation docs, or community confirmation of running Vercel outside its managed cloud.
